commandRules.message: Commit, worktree, merge: branch strategy, worktree path convention, commit rhythm, and merge rules are in the loaded docs/workflow.md.

rules.message: Source edit: the convention section of CLAUDE.md and docs/discipline.md are loaded in this session. Rules live there -- not summarized here.
Instruction document: the authoring policy is in the loaded {AUTHORING_POLICY_DOC}. Once a section is rewritten, run /doc-review <path> section "<title>" before committing.
Hook config: requires.reads paths and skill names must exist (a typo blocks every file the rule matches). Verify with the commands in .claude/hooks/README.md after editing.

Spec: the order around a spec (intent approval, spec, design review, remaining questions) and the writing rules are in the loaded docs/workflow.md. Code-structure design runs /design-review before implementation starts.
Design document: one per subsystem, edited by follow-up issues, status line draft/settled/implemented -- canon in the loaded docs/workflow.md "Design Documents".
Board: one-line cards, prerequisites as a '- prereq: `<id>`' line only, commit right after editing. Run bash scripts/board ready -- stale or broken edges must be zero.
